subject: Business Models
title: Loss Aversion in Upgrades
description: Learn Loss Aversion in Upgrades in one minute.

hook.text: People hate losing what they have more than they like gaining something new. Freemium exploits this.

buildup.text: Loss aversion means taking away a feature hurts more than offering a new one feels good.

discovery.text: Smart freemium products let users try premium features temporarily. Removing them creates loss aversion.

twist.text: LinkedIn shows you '5 people viewed your profile' but hides names. You've already lost something you never had.

climax.text: Loss aversion converts more users than feature promises. Show them what they'll lose, not what they'll gain.

punchline.text: Show the value, then take it away. Loss converts better than gain.

quiz.question: How does LinkedIn use loss aversion?
options: By showing profile viewers exist but hiding details
